nodes.description: Private mapping address=>uint256 tracking token balances, mutated by _transfer, destroy and issuance.
Nested mapping owner=>spender=>uint256 allowance, mutated by approve, transferFrom, increaseAllowance and decreaseAllowance.
Public total supply counter, decreased by destroy and increased by issuance.
Public token name string, set in constructor and mutable via rename.
Public token symbol string, set in constructor and mutable via rename.
Public decimals constant set to 18.
IPTokenFactory reference used for governance and pool-operator permission checks; replaceable via changeFactory.
Sets name/symbol and casts msg.sender into the pTokenFactory interface, granting it governance control.
Modifier requiring msg.sender to equal pTokenFactory.getGovernance() before executing privileged logic.
Modifier requiring pTokenFactory.getPTokenOperator(msg.sender) to be true before mint/burn logic.
View returning the configured factory address.
View returning _totalSupply.
View returning _balances[owner].
View returning _allowed[owner][spender].
Governance-only replacement of the pTokenFactory state variable; attacker-controlled factory would hijack all permission checks.
Governance-only update of name and symbol strings.
External transfer of value from msg.sender to 'to', delegating to _transfer.
Sets _allowed[msg.sender][spender] = value with non-zero spender check. No reentrancy hazard.
Spends allowance then calls _transfer; allowance is decremented with unchecked-style arithmetic expression.
Adds addedValue to _allowed[msg.sender][spender] and emits Approval.
Subtracts subtractedValue from _allowed[msg.sender][spender] and emits Approval.
Internal balance mutation routine executed by transfer and transferFrom without reentrancy guard.
Pool-only burn reducing _balances[account] and _totalSupply.
Pool-only mint increasing _balances[account] and _totalSupply.
Caller-controlled address used for permission checks, allowance ownership, transfers and factory initialization.
Unsigned subtraction/addition of balances in _transfer; raw arithmetic without explicit validation of value against balance.
Raw subtraction of value from _allowed[from][msg.sender] before the transfer is executed.
Subtraction of amount from _balances[account] and _totalSupply after a require check.
Addition of addedValue to allowance without cap or approval semantics.
Subtraction of subtractedValue from allowance with no explicit underflow pre-check.
External call pTokenFactory.getGovernance() whose return value controls privileged access.
External call pTokenFactory.getPTokenOperator(msg.sender) whose return value controls mint/burn access.
Name string parameter of the constructor.
Symbol string parameter of the constructor.
New factory contract address supplied to changeFactory.
New token name supplied to rename.
New token symbol supplied to rename.
Recipient address of transfer().
Amount transferred in transfer().
Spender address approved in approve().
Allowance amount set in approve().
Owner address whose allowance and balance are debited.
Recipient address in transferFrom().
Amount spent in transferFrom(), used in allowance arithmetic.
Spender whose allowance is increased.
Amount added to the allowance.
Spender whose allowance is decreased.
Amount removed from the allowance.
Source account of the internal balance mutation.
Destination account of the internal balance mutation.
Amount moved in the internal balance mutation.
Amount burned in destroy().
Account whose balance is reduced by destroy().
Amount minted in issuance().
Account credited by issuance().
Address queried by balanceOf().
Owner address queried by allowance().
Spender address queried by allowance().

edges.reason: msg.sender is compared against the factory governance address to gate privileged functions.
msg.sender is passed to getPTokenOperator to gate mint/burn functions.
Return value of the external getGovernance() call decides whether the governance gate passes.
Return value of the external getPTokenOperator() call decides whether the pool gate passes.
pTokenFactory state variable is the target of the getGovernance() call.
pTokenFactory state variable is the target of the getPTokenOperator() call.
msg.sender is cast into the IPTokenFactory interface and stored as the privileged factory.
Constructor writes the factory reference into pTokenFactory.
Constructor name parameter initializes token name.
Constructor symbol parameter initializes token symbol.
Constructor stores the provided name into the name state variable.
Constructor stores the provided symbol into the symbol state variable.
transfer() invokes the internal _transfer routine.
Recipient parameter flows into transfer().
Value parameter flows into transfer().
msg.sender supplies the 'from' account of transfer().
msg.sender is forwarded as the from-address into _transfer.
_transfer performs the unsigned balance arithmetic flagged as unsafe.
from parameter indexes the balance used in the arithmetic.
value parameter is subtracted from and added to balances.
Unsafe balance arithmetic writes the _balances mapping.
transferFrom() calls the internal _transfer routine.
from parameter drives allowance lookup and balance debit.
to parameter becomes the transfer destination.
value parameter is the amount transferred.
msg.sender is the spender whose allowance is debited.
transferFrom() decrements the allowance with raw subtraction.
value is subtracted from the allowance entry.
msg.sender indexes the allowance slot being decremented.
Allowance arithmetic writes the _allowed mapping.
spender parameter keys the allowance mapping.
value parameter is stored as the new allowance.
msg.sender is the allowance owner set by approve().
approve() writes the _allowed mapping.
spender parameter keys the allowance mapping.
addedValue parameter is added to the allowance.
msg.sender is the allowance owner in increaseAllowance().
increaseAllowance() performs allowance addition arithmetic.
addedValue flows into the allowance addition.
Allowance addition writes the _allowed mapping.
spender parameter keys the allowance mapping.
subtractedValue parameter is removed from the allowance.
msg.sender is the allowance owner in decreaseAllowance().
decreaseAllowance() performs allowance subtraction arithmetic.
subtractedValue flows into the allowance subtraction.
Allowance subtraction writes the _allowed mapping.
amount parameter is the burn quantity.
account parameter identifies the balance to burn.
destroy() executes balance and supply subtraction arithmetic.
Burn arithmetic writes the _balances mapping.
Burn arithmetic writes the _totalSupply variable.
amount parameter is the mint quantity.
account parameter identifies the balance to credit.
issuance() credits the _balances mapping.
issuance() increases the _totalSupply variable.
factory parameter is used to overwrite the factory reference.
changeFactory() rewrites the pTokenFactory state variable.
changeFactory() is guarded by the onlyGovernance modifier.
New name flows into the rename routine.
New symbol flows into the rename routine.
rename() writes the name state variable.
rename() writes the symbol state variable.
rename() is guarded by the onlyGovernance modifier.
getPTokenFactory() returns the stored factory address.
totalSupply() reads _totalSupply.
balanceOf() reads the _balances mapping.
owner parameter indexes the balance lookup.
allowance() reads the _allowed mapping.
owner parameter indexes the allowance lookup.
spender parameter indexes the allowance lookup.
destroy() is guarded by the onlyPool modifier.
issuance() is guarded by the onlyPool modifier.

normalization_plan.reason: Constructor name parameter is only used to initialize state inside the constructor node.
Constructor symbol parameter is only used to initialize state inside the constructor node.
New factory address is only consumed by changeFactory().
New name string is only consumed by rename().
New symbol string is only consumed by rename().
Recipient parameter is only consumed by transfer().
Value parameter is only consumed by transfer().
Spender parameter is only consumed by approve().
Allowance value parameter is only consumed by approve().
From parameter is only consumed by transferFrom().
To parameter is only consumed by transferFrom().
Value parameter directly feeds the allowance subtraction unsafe operation in transferFrom().
Spender parameter is only consumed by increaseAllowance().
addedValue directly feeds the allowance addition unsafe operation.
Spender parameter is only consumed by decreaseAllowance().
subtractedValue directly feeds the allowance subtraction unsafe operation.
From parameter is only consumed by the internal _transfer routine.
To parameter is only consumed by the internal _transfer routine.
value directly feeds the balance arithmetic unsafe operation inside _transfer.
amount directly feeds the burn arithmetic unsafe operation in destroy().
account parameter is only consumed as the target balance of destroy().
amount parameter is only consumed as the mint quantity of issuance().
account parameter is only consumed as the credited balance of issuance().
Owner parameter is only consumed by the balanceOf() view.
Owner parameter is only consumed by the allowance() view.
Spender parameter is only consumed by the allowance() view.
